about.title: About
about.subtitle: Dice!Next project information & tech stack
about.intro_text: Dice!Next is a modernized rebuild of Dice!, a QQ TRPG dice bot by Dice-Developer-Team supporting CoC, D&D, Fate, L5R and more. Dice!Next overhauls the architecture from a Win32 DLL + CoolQ plugin to a standalone server with a pluggable adapter system supporting OneBot v11, Discord, Kook and other platforms, paired with a modern React WebUI admin panel.
about.license: License: AGPL v3.0 | Original Copyright © Dice-Developer-Team
about.stack_backend_text: C++20 · Drogon · SQLite (sqlite_orm) · nlohmann/json · spdlog · WebSocket
about.stack_frontend_text: React 18 · TypeScript · Vite · Tailwind CSS · shadcn/ui · Zustand · i18next
about.stack_adapter_text: OneBot v11 · Bidirectional WebSocket · Pluggable IAdapter interface
v3_items: New architecture: DLL+CoolQ → standalone Drogon HTTP server + pluggable adapters
Multi-platform: IAdapter interface, OneBot v11 / Discord / Kook support
React WebUI: dashboard, playground, online code editor
Hot reload: deck uploads take effect instantly, dice rules save & refresh
i18n: Simplified Chinese / Traditional Chinese / English
v2_items: .game command · JS/Python scripting · multi-character sheets · batch generation
Localized WebUI · UTF-8 encoding · up to 999 dice × 9999 sides
about.update_desc: Check GitHub Releases and automatically select a working mirror for downloads.
about.update_install_confirm_desc: The bot will be offline briefly. The manager validates the package before replacement and automatically rolls back on failure. User data and third-party plugins under data are preserved.

about.update_settings_desc: Auto mode probes GitHub and built-in mirrors together, then uses the first successful source with valid content.
about.update_auto_check_desc: Check GitHub Releases in the background at the selected interval.
about.custom_mirror_desc: Must be an HTTPS URL prefix. The original GitHub download URL is appended to it.

webui.title: WebUI Settings
webui.autostart_desc: Auto-launch Dice!Next when Windows logs in (Windows only).
webui.raw_log_desc: When on, the console prints raw OneBot event JSON; off = human-readable.
webui.quote_reply_desc: When on, replies 'quote' the message that triggered the command (QQ reply-quote style). When off, replies are sent as plain messages without quoting.
webui.auto_card_desc: When on, after .st sets base attributes (CON/SIZ/POW…), HP/SAN/MP are auto-computed and stored, and a one-line HP/SAN/MP summary is appended. COC-style rules only.
webui.forward_long_desc: When on, any reply whose character count exceeds the threshold below is forced into a merged-forward (chat record) to avoid flooding; each forwarded bubble still respects the segment length. Group chats only, OneBot only.
webui.forward_threshold_desc: Replies longer than this are forced into a merged-forward (default 1200). Requires the toggle above.
webui.save_images_desc: When on, images in session logs are downloaded locally (data/logs/images) and embedded in the HTML export, so they survive the original links expiring.
webui.seg_len_desc: QQ caps single-message length. Replies longer than this are auto-split (ASCII=1, CJK=2; default 600 ≈ 300 Chinese chars; range 100–1000). Splits prefer line breaks, avoiding cutting a line in two.
webui.seg_enabled_desc: When off, long replies are sent as one message without splitting. QQ Official, Discord and KOOK never split.
webui.nick_wrap_desc: Prefix/suffix around the username in replies (e.g. '<Mu> rolls' for .r). Default < and >; leave both empty for no wrap.
webui.imghost_desc: QQ image links expire within hours. With 'Save log images' on, this decides how images stay viewable on the log site: upload to an image host for a stable link, then write that into the txt (never base64 to the log site).
webui.imghost_none: Don't upload (local only, no images on log site)
webui.imghost_generic_hint: Works with most hosts' 'multipart upload → JSON with URL' pattern. E.g. ImgBB (field image, path data.url) / sm.ms (field smfile, header Authorization) / Lsky (field file, path data.links.url, header Authorization: Bearer …). Switching hosts just means changing these fields.
webui.imghost_local_hint: The bot serves images itself (/api/logs/images/…). The log site must reach your bot over public HTTPS — needs a domain + reverse proxy + SSL; won't work behind NAT without a public IP.

banlist.cloudban_danger2: Level 2 and above (medium: malicious spam, attacks)

banlist.whitelist_only_desc: When on, only groups on the allow list will respond (others are ignored).
banlist.dicebot_desc: Auto-detected from each dice system's fixed .bot banner (Dice! / Dice!Next / OlivaDice / SealDice); manual entries allowed. When a user @s a dice bot with a command, this bot stays silent instead of proxy-rolling.
banlist.dicebot_empty: No dice bots detected yet. They are registered automatically when another bot replies to .bot in a group.
banlist.perm_users_desc: 0 = normal, 1-3 = trusted (can manage group settings remotely), 4 = admin (.trust/.admin/global ops), Master = highest (grant/revoke directly from the dropdown). Commands .trust <QQ> <level> / .admin add also work.
banlist.perm_add_user_ph: Enter QQ number or search existing user
banlist.perm_white_desc: Whitelisted users/groups are treated as trusted; with 'whitelist-only mode' below the bot serves only whitelisted groups.
banlist.perm_white_group_desc: With 'whitelist-only mode' the bot serves only listed groups. Users don't need whitelisting — trust levels cover that.

ai.title: AI
ai.desc: Connect OpenAI-compatible models (multiple providers/models). Used by upcoming reply polish/translation features.
ai.chat_desc: When @'d / a keyword matches / by standby probability, generate a natural reply from persona + recent group conversation. Group chats only, rate-limited.
ai.chat_trigger_desc: Always replies when @'d or a keyword hits (ignores cooldown); other messages use the standby probability below.
ai.chat_keywords_ph: e.g. bot, hello, tell a joke
ai.chat_filters_ph:
One word/phrase per line to filter out, e.g.:
[image]
ad signature
some watermark
ai.chat_filters_note: Before feeding the AI (current message, context, group memory) these are removed from the text; matched literally and deleted. Useful for stripping watermarks, signatures, spam phrases, etc.
ai.chat_persona_ph: e.g. a chatty cat-girl dice bot that loves to banter…
ai.chat_prompt_ph: Empty = built-in default. Click Load default to view/edit.
ai.chat_note: When @'d or a keyword hits it always replies and ignores cooldown; the standby probability only affects other messages — keep it low or it will butt in often. Chat really calls the model (cost + latency); on failure/unconfigured it won't reply.
ai.mem_desc: Once chat scrolls past the recent window, older messages are compressed in batches into a per-group summary and injected as background, so the bot remembers things from further back.
ai.mem_rounds: Kept rounds (recent verbatim / fold batch size)
ai.mem_prompt_ph: How to compress history into a summary…
ai.mem_note: The model is only called once enough aged-out messages accumulate into a batch (naturally rate-limited, cost-controlled); on failure the old summary is kept.
ai.mem_empty: No summaries yet (click View to refresh).
ai.mlong_desc: Extracts durable facts (character sheets/plot/agreements) from chat, embeds and stores them; at chat time the most relevant few are retrieved by similarity to the current topic and injected, so the bot 'remembers' settings from long ago.
ai.mlong_prompt_ph: How to extract persistent facts from chat…
ai.mlong_note: Extraction and retrieval both call the model/embedding API (incurs cost); the embedding model is separate from the chat model (e.g. text-embedding-3-small). Fold batching reuses 'Kept rounds' above.
ai.mlong_empty: No facts yet (click View to refresh).
ai.tools: Tool calling (let the bot really roll / read sheets)
ai.tools_desc: When on, during chat the bot can use function-calling to invoke real features: actually roll dice when a number is needed, read character-sheet attributes, draw decks — instead of making numbers up. Requires a model that supports tools (function-calling).
ai.tools_set_attr: set_attr (writes the sender's sheet · risky, off by default)
ai.tools_search_help: search_help (find entries in the help docs)
ai.vision_desc: When a message has images, a multimodal model recognizes the image content into a text description that is injected into the chat, so the bot can 'see' the image and respond. Only runs when triggered (@'d/keyword) to control cost. The vision model can differ from the chat model.
ai.vision_note: Recognition makes an extra multimodal request (cost + latency). Live messages use the image's direct link; locally cached images are sent as base64. The chosen model must support vision input.
ai.vision_pass_url_desc: When on, passes QQ image URL directly to the LLM (fast but links may expire); when off, downloads and sends as base64 (slower but reliable).
ai.wl_desc: When on, only whitelisted groups/private chats can use AI chat and NPCs; non-whitelisted groups are refused even if a group admin sends .ai on. Prevents unauthorized groups from burning API credits.
ai.wl_empty: The whitelist is empty — with it enabled no group can use AI. Add authorized groups or users.
ai.wl_note: The whitelist only gates AI chat/NPC/group-memory triggers; reply polish and translation are global features and unaffected.
ai.tools_note: Each tool round makes an extra model request (more cost + latency); the last round forces a text reply. Only active when Chat is enabled.
ai.npc_desc: Define NPCs (name / persona / knowledge / trigger words). When a group message mentions an NPC's name or hits a trigger, the bot replies in that NPC's voice and knowledge (reusing memory + tool calling). Great for playing an innkeeper, a mysterious informant, etc. during a session.
ai.npc_empty: No NPCs yet — click 'Add NPC' below to create one.
ai.npc_mood_tip: When on, the NPC keeps a favor score (-100~100) and mood per player; its tone follows the relationship. After each interaction a model judges the favor change (one extra request).
ai.npc_persona_ph: A gruff, hearty middle-aged man with an accent…
ai.npc_knowledge_ph: Knows town rumors; the black market is in the dock back-alley…
ai.npc_note: When triggered, replies as the NPC, taking priority over the default bot chat; still subject to cooldown / memory / tools. A too-common name may over-trigger — use trigger words for precision.
ai.params_desc: Shared by all AI calls (polish/translate use a lower temperature for faithfulness).
ai.cov_desc: Applies only to the checked reply categories.
ai.master_desc: Master switch. When off, all AI features are inactive.
ai.warn: ⚠️ When on, AI features may incur significant cost (billed per your configured models), and AI-processed replies will have latency (depends on network + model speed). Set a cost/token limit per model.
ai.no_models: No models yet — click "Add model" to start.
ai.name_ph: Display name (e.g. GPT-4o mini / local Qwen)
ai.polish_desc: Before sending roll/check replies, the model polishes them by persona + context (adds a little latency to that reply).
ai.polish_persona_ph: e.g. a tsundere cat-girl dice bot, short and playful…
ai.polish_note: Polish only applies to roll/check replies; the model must keep the original numbers and success/fail results. On failure or timeout, the original is sent.
ai.trans_desc: Define languages below, then send .lang <keyword> in a group/private chat to switch; replies are generated in the default language first, then translated by the model before sending (cached — identical text isn't billed twice).
ai.trans_no_langs: No languages yet — click Add. E.g. name "German", keywords "de, german, 德语".
ai.trans_lang_kw: .lang keywords, comma-separated (e.g. de, german, 德语)
ai.trans_note: On failure or timeout the original is sent. Switching back to a built-in language or .lang clr disables translation.
ai.stage_note: Tip: send .r on the Playground page to preview polish/translation without joining a group.
ai.master_off_hint: AI master switch is off. Enable it on the Models page first.
ai.polish_prompt_ph: Leave empty to use the built-in default prompt
ai.polish_prompt_note: Custom system prompt; click Load default to fill in the built-in template for editing.
ai.trans_prompt_ph: Leave empty to use the built-in default prompt
ai.trans_prompt_note: Use {lang} as a placeholder for the target language; leave empty for the built-in default.

settings.js_fetch_desc: Open by default (matching SealDice raw fetch); strict mode restores the API switch and SSRF/whitelist checks.
settings.js_fetch_strict_desc: When on, JS plugin fetch must pass the external-API switch and whitelist, and blocks LAN/loopback hosts.
settings.plugin_verify_desc: With a PEM public key configured, uploaded JS/Lua plugins must carry a signature or installation is rejected. Empty = verification off.
settings.plugin_verify_hint: Use tools/sign-plugin.py to generate keys and sign plugins; without a key, current behavior is kept.
settings.heartbeat_desc: Periodically report this bot's online status to a public service so players can check its availability
settings.heartbeat_master_desc: Entering either field overrides automatic detection as a pair. Leave both empty to use the first OneBot owner and their saved player nickname.
settings.heartbeat_master_effective_none: No reportable OneBot owner information was found
settings.heartbeat_adapter_keys_desc: Each bot has its own API key. Configure one on every adapter in Platform Connections.
settings.heartbeat_token_hint: Generate the shared API Key from Dice Bindings in the Account Center:
settings.heartbeat_public_desc: Allow the service site to publicly display this bot's online status
settings.heartbeat_test_success_desc: Verified {{count}} adapter(s). The API key and network connection are working.
settings.heartbeat_test_rate_limited: Verified {{total}} adapter(s). The server ignored {{count}} duplicate report(s) sent too soon; the API key and network connection are working.
settings.censor_desc: Original Dice!-compatible command filtering using only your custom rule list.
settings.censor_behavior: Only incoming prefixed commands are checked. Spaces and ASCII punctuation are skipped and English matching is case-insensitive. Trust level 4 and Masters bypass checks; Notice only reports, while Caution and above reject according to trust. No word list is bundled, normal chat is not scanned, and bot output is not rewritten.
settings.scope_desc: Settings with a source badge resolve in this order: account override > adapter type override > global default. Server-level settings always remain global.
settings.scope_current_global: Editing: defaults for all adapters and accounts
settings.message_format_desc_global: Master rich-text switch. Turning it off forces every platform and every Markdown-marked template back to traditional text in one click.
settings.message_format_desc_scoped: Disable rich replies for this platform or account. A local opt-in only works while the global master switch is enabled.
settings.message_format_rich: On: supported platforms render Markdown or cards
settings.message_format_hint_rich: Discord uses embeds, KOOK uses CardMessage, and QQ Official prefers Markdown. Rejected rich messages retry as text. OneBot always uses traditional text.
settings.message_format_hint_plain: Bold, code, and other Markdown in templates is converted to readable plain text before sending, so formatting marks are not exposed to users.
settings.message_format_scope_hint: A scoped setting cannot bypass a disabled global master switch.
settings.scope_reset_success: Restored inheritance from the parent scope
settings.scope_global_only: This constraint applies to every group and is always global.
settings.expression_desc: Controls parser order for generic rolls. Fallback occurs only for unsupported syntax; evaluation errors such as division by zero never reroll with another engine.
settings.expression_enhanced_desc: Parses with Dice!Next → OneDice → DiceScript, continuing only when the current engine does not support the syntax.
settings.expression_compatible_desc: Parses with Dice!Next → OneDice, without DiceScript.
settings.expression_original_desc: Uses only the original Dicebot expression syntax in Dice!Next, with no compatibility layer.
settings.expression_custom_desc: Choose one or more engines and set a fixed parser priority.
settings.expression_order_hint: Engines are tried top to bottom. The order is fixed rather than randomized per roll so issues remain reproducible.
settings.expression_engine_dicenext_desc: Original Dicebot expressions with Dice!Next-native output.
settings.expression_engine_dicescript_desc: Full DiceScript-compatible C99 runtime maintained by Dice!Next, including variables, containers, functions, statements, templates, and TRPG dice.
settings.expression_need_one: Custom mode must keep at least one engine
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage API Key and app preferences
settings.webpw_desc: Once set, opening the admin panel requires this password. Save an empty value to disable login.
settings.webpw_placeholder: New password (8–64 chars with upper/lower/digit/symbol; empty disables login)
settings.webpw_hint: A new password must include uppercase, lowercase, a digit and an ASCII symbol; CJK/full-width characters and spaces are not allowed. Changing or clearing it invalidates existing sessions.
settings.server_desc: Listen address for the admin panel and API. 0.0.0.0 means all interfaces.
settings.server_hint: The HTTP listener binds at startup; changes require a program restart (the listen port can't be hot-swapped).
settings.restarting: Restarting — reopen the panel at the new address shortly…
settings.api_key_desc: Authentication key for accessing the Dice! backend API. Must match the key set in the backend config file.
settings.log_desc: How events are shown in the console/log.
settings.log_raw: Verbose mode: log every event (heartbeats, API responses) as readable interpretations (off = only messages and key events)
settings.master_desc: Bot owners with top privileges (boton/botoff, ban/allow lists, etc.). Multiple allowed, per-platform.
settings.master_id_placeholder_qq: Enter the master's OpenID (QQ Official account identifier)
settings.master_openid_hint: You can find your OpenID in the binding info on the Players page, or query it with the .info command.
settings.master_inherit_desc: When an OpenID of the QQ Official bot is bound to a real QQ that is already a Master on any platform, that user is automatically treated as a Master on this official bot.
settings.master_qq_need_account: QQ Official OpenIDs are scoped per AppID; you must select a specific bot account
settings.timezone_desc: Unify log uploads, audit, scheduled tasks, backup names and all user-facing time displays.
settings.timezone_hint: Takes effect immediately. Times are still stored as UTC; display and upload convert using this timezone.
settings.prefix_desc: Prefixes that mark a command (e.g. . 。 ! ！). A message must start with one to be treated as a command.
settings.prefix_hint: One character per prefix recommended; keep at least one.
settings.approval_desc: How the bot auto-handles friend requests and group invites.
settings.approval_friend_group_used: Auto-approve only users with group command history
settings.approval_friend_nonblacklist: Auto-approve users not on the blacklist
settings.approval_keyword_ph: Keyword the verify message must contain
settings.logsite_desc: Where .log end uploads session logs. Self-hosted sites work (SealDice-compatible protocol).
settings.logsite_unofficial: ⚠️ This is not the official log site — logs will be sent to a third-party server; make sure you trust it.
settings.logsite_format_legacy: Legacy (multipart txt POST, for old self-hosted endpoints)
settings.approval_group_reject_nonfriend_hint: Invites from non-friends (ad accounts often mass-invite) are auto-rejected; if the bot is force-added to a group without approval, it announces and leaves immediately. Masters and whitelisted users are exempt.
settings.approval_note: "Reject by illegal group-name keyword" needs the bot to be in the group, so it belongs to the auto-leave rules (planned).
settings.respond_self_desc: When on, messages sent by the bot's own account are also processed, so you can control the bot by sending commands from the bot account in group/private chats (built-in commands, plugins and custom replies all work). Self-echo dedup (the bot's own replies won't re-trigger it) and a cross-bot loop guard (a zero-width char is inserted when a reply starts with a command, so other bots aren't triggered) are built in. Off by default.
settings.poke_desc: Reaction when poked. 'Mapped command' takes priority: run it as a message from the poker (a built-in command like .jrrp, a plugin command, or a custom-reply trigger). Leave empty to send the reply text below.
settings.welcome_min_desc: Set global minimum delay and cooldown for welcome messages
settings.global_desc: Original console-style global config. Items marked "recorded" are stored but not yet wired to behavior.
settings.legacy_desc: Import character cards, player profiles, blacklist, custom replies, etc. from an original Dice! [DiceData] folder.
settings.legacy_hint: Enter the legacy Dice data directory (the one containing conf/ and user/). Re-runnable; existing items are skipped or updated.
settings.legacy_result: Imported: cards {{cards}}, players {{users}}, blacklist {{black}}, replies {{replies}}, help {{help}}, messages {{msgs}}, masters {{masters}}, sensitive words {{censor}}
settings.legacy_result2: mods {{mods}}, deck files {{decks}}, group settings {{settings}} (across {{groups}} groups). Mods/decks take effect after restart.
settings.auto_card_desc: When on, after .st sets base attributes (CON/SIZ/POW…), HP/SAN/MP are auto-computed and stored, and a one-line HP/SAN/MP summary is appended. COC-style rules only.
settings.autostart_desc: Auto-launch Dice!Next when Windows logs in (Windows only).
settings.quote_reply_desc: When on, replies 'quote' the message that triggered the command (QQ reply-quote style). When off, replies are sent as plain messages without quoting.
settings.save_images_desc: When on, images in session logs are downloaded locally (data/logs/images) and embedded in the HTML export, so they survive the original links expiring.
settings.seg_len_desc: QQ caps single-message length. Replies longer than this are auto-split (ASCII=1, CJK=2; default 600 ≈ 300 Chinese chars; range 100–1000). Splits prefer line breaks, avoiding cutting a line in two.
settings.seg_enabled_desc: When off, long replies are sent as one message without splitting. QQ Official, Discord and KOOK never split.
settings.nick_wrap_desc: Prefix/suffix around the username in replies (e.g. '<Mu> rolls' for .r). Default < and >; leave both empty for no wrap.
settings.forward_long_desc: When on, any reply whose character count exceeds the threshold below is forced into a merged-forward (chat record) to avoid flooding; each forwarded bubble still respects the segment length. Group chats only, OneBot only.
settings.forward_threshold_desc: Replies longer than this are forced into a merged-forward (default 1200). Requires the toggle above.
settings.imgsend_desc: Images inserted into replies are stored as [img,file=<local path>] and converted at send time. base64 embeds the image data directly, so NapCat receives it from any device (default); HTTP link sends an http://<host>/api/assets/… URL, which requires NapCat's device to reach that host.
settings.imgsend_httpurl: HTTP link (NapCat must reach this machine)
settings.imgsend_host_hint: Empty = localhost:<current port>. If NapCat runs on another device, use this machine's LAN IP (e.g. 192.168.1.5:18088) or a public domain.
settings.notice_desc: Register a group/private chat as a 'notice window' to receive owner-level notices (permission changes, friend requests, group invites). You can also use .notice on/off in chat (master only).
settings.notice_empty: No notice windows yet. Click 'Add window' or send .notice on in the target chat.
settings.notice_hint: Levels: Routine = daily ops like trust changes; Important = friend requests & new friends / group invites / leaving or being removed from groups / scheduled tasks / global switches; Critical = admin grants/revokes / blacklisting; Errors = runtime errors (ERROR logs, throttled to one per 60s). The audit log records all notice events (data/audit/).
settings.imghost_desc: QQ image links expire within hours. With 'Save log images' on, this decides how images stay viewable on the log site: upload to an image host for a stable link, then write that into the txt (never base64 to the log site).
settings.imghost_none: Don't upload (local only, no images on log site)
settings.imghost_generic_hint: Works with most hosts' 'multipart upload → JSON with URL' pattern. E.g. ImgBB (field image, path data.url) / sm.ms (field smfile, header Authorization) / Lsky (field file, path data.links.url, header Authorization: Bearer …). Switching hosts just means changing these fields.
settings.imghost_local_hint: The bot serves images itself (/api/logs/images/…). The log site must reach your bot over public HTTPS — needs a domain + reverse proxy + SSL; won't work behind NAT without a public IP.
settings.logsite_format_seal_v105: SealDice V105 (Parquet columnar, smaller; log site must support it)
settings.logsite_format_dicenext: DiceNext (default, zstd-compressed, small; needs DiceNext log site/painter)
settings.approval_group_name_keyword_hint: After joining, the group name is fetched; if it contains any keyword the bot leaves and notifies the master (name is unavailable at invite time).

groups.title: Group Management
groups.subtitle: Remotely enable/disable groups, edit the bot's group card and remarks, leave or message.
groups.account_scope_hint: Switches, cards, welcome messages, plugins, and the active log are stored separately for the selected account.
groups.add_placeholder: Enter a group ID to add...
groups.empty_hint: Groups appear after the bot joins or after .bot/.group is used; you can also add by ID.
groups.card_hint: The bot's nickname in this group
groups.message_prompt: Text to send to this group:
groups.remove_confirm: Remove only the settings record for group {{id}} (won't leave). Continue?
groups.plugins_hint: Enable/disable plugins & mods per group. When off, that plugin's commands won't respond in this group (other groups and the global setting are unaffected).
groups.files_unavailable: Group files unavailable (requires a connected NapCat/go-cqhttp adapter).
groups.ai_switch_desc: When off, this group won't trigger AI chat/NPC and won't build group memory. The global switch on the AI page must be on first. You can also use .ai on/off in the group (admin only).
groups.ai_clear_confirm: Clear all AI memory (summary + facts) for '{name}'?
groups.ai_no_memory: No AI memory for this group yet.
groups.ai_memory_note: Memory is built up as the conversation rolls; after clearing it re-accumulates during later chat.
groups.lock_confirm:
Completely disable "{{name}}"?
This is a hard shutdown: nobody in the group can re-enable the bot - only this page can.
groups.bot_card_hint: The bot's display name in this group
groups.no_perm: (bot is not an admin here, member management unavailable)
groups.ban_prompt: Mute for how many minutes? (0 = unmute)
groups.kick_confirm: Kick this member from the group?
groups.members_truncated: Showing first {{n}} of {{total}}, use search to narrow down
groups.chat_placeholder: Type a message, Enter to send to the group...
groups.chat_empty: No messages yet - group chatter and your sends will show here
groups.log_empty: No session logs for this group
groups.log_confirm_delete: Delete log "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
groups.inviter_hint: Whoever invited the bot; treated as a group admin.
groups.group_locale_hint: Bot replies in this group use the selected language (same as .lang in group).
groups.chat_sticker_hint: Click + to upload an image as a local sticker; click a sticker to send it.
groups.welcome_settings_hint: Set welcome message, delay and cooldown for this group
groups.files_upload_queued: "{{name}}" queued; it will appear once QQ processes it

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.subtitle: DiceNext feature progress - what's done and what's planned.

broadcast.rules: How it works: broadcasts are NOT mass-sent (to avoid spam/ban). Each group receives it ONCE, appended to the reply the next time that group triggers any dice command. Only one pending broadcast is buffered; creating/replacing overwrites the previous one and resets the count. Max 200 characters.

helpdoc.title: Help Docs
helpdoc.desc: Aggregates help entries from four sources — built-in topics, rule packs, plugins, and custom docs. Search, edit, and manage them here.
helpdoc.name: Doc name
helpdoc.readonly_hint: Help from this source ships with its rule pack or plugin and is read-only here; edit the rule pack or plugin to change it.
helpdoc.need_name: Please enter a doc name first

commands.title: Command List
commands.subtitle: All commands with examples; roll reply text is customizable here (with variables, one-click reset).
commands.compat_note: Fully compatible with OlivaDice (青果) and SealDice (海豹) command styles.
commands.var_hint: Reply variables: {nick} name · {res} result · {attr} attribute · {roll} roll detail · {rate} rate · {level} level (varies per command; reset to restore defaults).
commands.var_insert_hint: Click a variable below to insert at the cursor; variables are validated on save.
commands.warn_missing: Missing variable(s) {{vars}} (can save, but they won't appear)
commands.format_hint: Legacy templates and plugin replies stay plain; rendering or OneBot downgrade only applies to explicit Markdown.
commands.variable_styles_desc: Choose a style for variables already used by this template. Any non-plain style enables Markdown automatically and updates both previews immediately.
commands.preview_hint: Preview variables use sample values; OneBot output is generated by the server's actual downgrade path.
commands.delete_orphan_confirm: Delete orphan text {{key}}? It will no longer be shown after deletion.
commands.orphan_empty: No orphan text (after importing legacy data, unmappable original messages appear here)
commands.v2_tooltip: The gray text below is the original Dice!V2 key
commands.global_vars_desc: These work in any text (e.g. the bot's self-name). Command-specific vars are in the outer dialog.
commands.persona_manage_desc: Create, copy, edit, delete personas, or set the default.
commands.persona_editing: Editing reply text of persona "{{name}}"; changes save to that persona.

players.title: Player Management
players.subtitle: Profiles of everyone who has used the bot (auto-created).
players.confirm_del_card: Delete character card "{{name}}"? Its attributes and group bindings will be removed.
players.not_friend: Not a friend (profile from group commands) — nothing to delete

schedules.need_once_date: Please pick a run date for the one-shot task
schedules.need_account: Please select an account to send from
schedules.run_fail: Execution failed (no connected adapter for that platform?)
schedules.run_cond_miss: Note: the condition is not met right now — a scheduled fire would be skipped (this was a forced run)
schedules.run_leave_confirm: This task’s action is LEAVE GROUP. Running it now will actually leave group {{id}}. Continue?
schedules.target_id_ph: Group ID / User ID (* = all groups)
schedules.subtitle: Push messages to groups/DMs on a daily schedule (single-target push, not mass send).
schedules.add_hint: Set a trigger time + target to run automatically. Add a condition for cause→effect; content supports variables/functions.
schedules.name: Name
schedules.condition_hint: Empty = fire on schedule unconditionally; inactive>=7 = only if this group had no commands for ≥7 days (with the leave action: 'leave if idle 7 days'). Supports >= > <= < ==.
schedules.plugin_command_hint: Runs only an enabled JS/Lua plugin in the selected chat with a low-privilege scheduler context; built-in admin commands are not executed.
schedules.need_fields: Fill in the target; send and plugin-command actions also require content

flavor.title: Text flavor
flavor.desc: Switch the "flavor" layer of reply text. The original flavor overlays the original Dice! wording style and can be switched back anytime.
flavor.on_desc: . The following keys use original Dice! wording:
flavor.var_note: Original variable placeholders ({pc}, {char}, {attr}, etc.) are auto-mapped to DiceNext variables.

counter.title: Counter management
counter.desc: View, edit and reset persistent counters of the causal rule engine

persona.title: Bot persona
persona.desc: Manage multiple named persona texts. Each persona can override different reply texts and be switched per group.
persona.copy_desc: Copy "{{name}}" as a new persona; enter a name:
persona.del_confirm: Delete persona "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone.
persona.new_desc: Create a new persona template; add override texts in the editor afterwards.
persona.empty: No persona templates yet - click "New persona" to create one
persona.name: Name

causal.empty: No causal rules yet - click "New rule" to create one

v2.tpl_desc: Click one to apply a ready-made rule, then tweak the text.
v2.tpl_gacha_d: One easter egg per user per minute
v2.hint_contains: Fires when the text appears anywhere in the message (most common).
v2.hint_equals: The whole message must equal this exactly.
v2.hint_starts: Fires when the message begins with this text.
v2.hint_regex: Regex match; capture groups can be used in the reply as {$1}, {$2}.
v2.hint_sender_is: Only the listed QQ ids trigger it (comma-separated).
v2.hint_sender_not: The listed QQ ids will not trigger it (comma-separated).
v2.hint_in_groups: Only fires in the listed group ids (comma-separated).
v2.hint_counter: Compares a counter's current value against the condition.
v2.no_cond: No conditions yet — with none, ANY message triggers it.
v2.reply_ph: Reply text (one per line; a random one is picked)
v2.reply_hint: Click a chip below to insert a variable; the name in {counter:name} must match the counter above.
v2.counter_hint: Counters persist; per-user/per-group/global decides whether each is separate or shared.
v2.api_hint: Fetches the URL and stores the result into the variable name; use {name} in the reply (enable external requests in Settings).
v2.cooldown_hint: Cooldown = seconds this rule won't re-fire after triggering; 0 = no limit. The key decides per-user/per-group/global.
v2.test_hint: Type a message to see whether this rule fires and what it replies.

ed.name: Rule name
ed.reply_ph: Reply templates (one per line, random pick)

backup.legacy_hint: Enter the legacy Dice data directory (the one containing conf/ and user/). Re-runnable; existing items are skipped or updated.
backup.legacy_result: Imported: cards {{cards}}, players {{users}}, blacklist {{black}}, replies {{replies}}, help {{help}}, messages {{msgs}}, masters {{masters}}, sensitive words {{censor}}
backup.legacy_result2: mods {{mods}}, deck files {{decks}}, group settings {{settings}} (across {{groups}} groups). Mods/decks take effect after restart.

backup.subtitle: Import legacy Dice! data, and back up / restore.
backup.backup_restore_desc: Choose data by purpose, save the backup on the server, or restore from a backup file.
backup.restore_confirm: The restore will be applied the next time Dice!Next starts. Current data will be retained as a rollback copy. Continue?
backup.restore_staged_desc: Restart Dice!Next to complete the restore.
backup.restore_warning: The restore is applied after the next restart. The current data/ directory and configuration are retained as a rollback copy.

legacy_import.title: Import legacy data
legacy_import.desc: Import an original Dice! V2 data directory (decks, mods, character sheets, etc.)
legacy_import.need_dir: Enter the legacy data directory path
legacy_import.done_desc: Decks: {{decks}} ok, mods: {{mods}} ok, plugins: {{plugins}} ok
legacy_import.summary: Converted {{links}} message links, {{notices}} notification windows, {{sessions}} legacy game sessions and {{logs}} transcripts ({{logMessages}} records). Keep the original directory and verify the result in a test group.

chatcfg.title: Chat history
chatcfg.desc: Simulated-chat messages persist to a separate database (chat.db) and are pruned after the retention period; recalled messages are flagged but content is kept.

usergroup.title: User group
usergroup.desc: Configure the bot's user group: require every group to have at least one user-group member, and invite new friends to join.
usergroup.enforce: Auto-leave groups with no user-group member (checked on join events)
usergroup.invite: Privately invite new friends who are not in the user group
usergroup.hint: OneBot has no standard group-invite-card API; the invite is sent as a private text (with the group ID).

friendclean.title: Automatic Friend & Group Cleanup
friendclean.desc: Periodically removes inactive friends and leaves groups according to blacklist and group-size rules.
friendclean.hint: 0 disables the corresponding limit. Checked every 12 hours; masters and trusted users are exempt from friend cleanup.
